annotation.title_clean: 産業用ロボットに係る労働安全衛生規則第150条の4の施行通達の一部改正に当たっての留意事項について
annotation.title_en: Points to Note on the Partial Amendment of the Enforcement Notice for Article 150-4 of the Industrial Safety and Health Regulations Concerning Industrial Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 厚生労働省労働基準局安全衛生部安全課 (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Safety Division)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MHLW notice (24 Dec 2013) to prefectural labour bureaus giving points to note when applying the amended enforcement circular on Article 150-4 of the Industrial Safety and Health Regulations, covering collaborative industrial robots: risk assessment guidelines, ISO/TS 15066 force limits, 500mm clearance, and forthcoming JIS equivalents of ISO 10218.
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk assessment must follow the hazard/harm investigation guideline and the comprehensive machinery safety guideline.
Manipulator force and kinetic energy kept structurally below ISO/TS 15066 human-harm thresholds (once established) can indicate no danger.
Clearance of at least 500mm between manipulator and surrounding structures, or manual release without drive power, indicates no entrapment danger.
JIS B8433-1 and -2 are being prepared to correspond to ISO 10218-1/-2:2011.
